charts.question: Error at matched reporting coverage
charts.supported_finding: At matched coverage, quality and motion policies report the same number of windows in each cohort.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The ECG reference is algorithm-derived. The external cohort changes the activity setting; both studies use Empatica wrist hardware. Reported accuracy applies only to the activity and ECG eligibility definitions.
